component-o.description-s: JST GH side-entry SMT header, 1x6, 1.25 mm pitch, tin, 1.0 A per contact (AWG 26), 50 V, -25~85 C (indoor boards). Sits at the board edge (mating along +y). Few-wire camera harness (RAW_5V x2, GND x2, PDB, mic audio; 1.33x margin over 0.75 A per pin). Mates with GHR-06V-S / SSHL-002T-P0.2.

connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard plus the on-board part of the mate keepout (right-angle at the board edge: the mate overhangs the edge)

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: JST GH catalog: GHR-06V-S housing B 8.75 x 4.15 x 5.7 mm (p2 table); side-entry header 4.25 high; mated housing overhangs the board edge, so the board gives only the courtyard; insertion depth estimated as for SM14B-GHS-TB
